scope: TRAIN ONLY exploratory description and untuned naive forecasts. No learned model, validation/test evaluation, causal claim, or strategy execution.
aggregation: Hourly MAE within day, mean within household, then equal household mean; sources reported separately. Correlation uses one mean point per household, not independent overlapping days.

matched_iflex.selection_rule: Largest train-only group with identical resident count, complete released appliance type/present/count/subtype vector, region, target day and 24-hour experimental price; ties by repr(input key), no target-based selection.
matched_iflex.matching_does_not_establish: Equal device ratings, unrecorded appliances, actual operations, identical dwellings, or identical weather exposure.
